economy.summary: Her campaign says she offers real solutions to rising costs that are squeezing working families and aims to make everyday life more affordable.
economy.short: Says she offers solutions to rising costs, making life affordable.

taxes.summary: Her campaign says she will defend homeowners and seniors from crushing property taxes and rising utility costs.
taxes.short: Pledges to defend homeowners, seniors from property taxes, utility costs.

education.summary: Her campaign says she will strengthen public schools and expand real school choice, and ensure public schools have the resources they need.
education.short: Supports strengthening public schools and expanding school choice.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign says she will protect access to affordable healthcare and prescription drugs.
healthcare.short: Pledges to protect access to affordable healthcare, prescription drugs.

guns.summary: Her campaign describes a public-safety platform to support law enforcement and first responders and deliver safer and cleaner streets; the site does not detail a firearms policy.
guns.short: Pledges to support law enforcement, first responders; deliver safer streets.

economy.summary: His campaign says the best way to stimulate the economy is investing in modernizing aging infrastructure, and he supports expanding public transit and climate-proofing Pennsylvania infrastructure.
economy.short: Supports investing in modernizing infrastructure and expanding public transit.

taxes.summary: His campaign says he will fight for a tax structure that makes massive corporations pay their fair share.
taxes.short: Wants tax structure making massive corporations pay their fair share.

abortion.summary: His campaign says he supports access to safe and legal abortion, birth control, and emergency contraception, calls the overturning of Roe v. Wade wrong, and opposes rollbacks or restrictions on reproductive healthcare.
abortion.short: Supports access to legal abortion; opposes restrictions on reproductive care.

education.summary: His campaign supports fair funding of public schools regardless of district wealth, greater accountability for charter schools, fixing school infrastructure, and better pay for teachers.
education.short: Supports fair public-school funding, charter accountability, better teacher pay.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says healthcare is a basic human right and supports universal coverage that is free at the point of service, without premiums, deductibles, or copays.
healthcare.short: Supports universal healthcare coverage free at the point of service.

energy.summary: His campaign supports a severance tax on gas drillers, a moratorium on new fracking pending study of current drilling, joining the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, and growth in renewable energy.
energy.short: Supports severance tax, fracking moratorium, RGGI, and renewable energy.

guns.summary: His campaign supports background checks on private long-gun sales, extreme risk protection orders, repealing Act 192, and prohibiting the sale or transfer of assault weapons to private citizens.
guns.short: Supports background checks, extreme risk protection orders, assault-weapons transfer ban.
